description: Wildcard Blocking on, plain feed lines that are xn-- labels decoding to an IDNA deviation character (ß, ς, ZWNJ, ZWJ): IDNA2003 (Python) and UTS #46 non-transitional (Go) disagree on whether the line is a registrable domain

cases.description: the feed line xn--strae-oqa.de (straße: ß (U+00DF)) blocks the listed name itself: Python keeps it as exact data although its IDNA2003 round trip refuses the label

with Wildcard Blocking on, a subdomain of the feed line xn--strae-oqa.de (straße: ß (U+00DF)): Python's IDNA2003 nameprep maps or deletes the deviation character, refuses the label as non-canonical and never makes it a zone, so the subdomain relays; Go (UTS #46 non-transitional) keeps the character, makes the line a zone and blocks the subdomain, as the owner decided (Go result signed off: https://github.com/pfBlockerNG/pfBlockerNG/issues/3511#issuecomment-6758313592)
